sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: President Trump announces a $12 billion bailout of American farmers.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统宣布对美国农民进行120亿美元的救助。

sentences.en: Why the trade war he started to help them now requires taxpayers to save them.
sentences.zh: 为什么他为了帮助农民而发起的贸易战，现在却需要纳税人来拯救他们。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, July 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月25日，星期三。

sentences.en: And I say it now, America firSt. America firSt.
sentences.zh: 我现在就要说，美国优先。美国优先。

sentences.en: So when he was a candidate, Donald Trump made trade a big issue on the campaign trail, and he promised to do something very different from his predecessors.
sentences.zh: 所以当唐纳德·特朗普还是候选人时，他在竞选活动中将贸易作为一个重大议题，并承诺要与他的前任们采取非常不同的做法。

sentences.en: Renegotiate our foreign trade deals.
sentences.zh: 重新谈判我们的对外贸易协定。

sentences.en: He promised to renegotiate trade deals.
sentences.zh: 他承诺重新谈判贸易协定。

sentences.en: NAFTA.
sentences.zh: 《北美自由贸易协定》（NAFTA）。

sentences.en: You heard about NAFTA.
sentences.zh: 你听说过 NAFTA。

sentences.en: The worst, the worst trade deal ever signed by anybody at any time.
sentences.zh: 这是有史以来任何人签署的最糟糕的贸易协定。

sentences.en: And I am going to withdraw the United States from the Trans-Pacific Partnership.
sentences.zh: 我将让美国退出《跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》（TPP）。

sentences.en: Vowed to pull out of a trade deal called the Trans-Pacific Partnership.
sentences.zh: 他发誓要退出一项名为《跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》的贸易协定。

sentences.en: We will put a stop to all of that on November 8th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月8日终止这一切。

sentences.en: But after President Trump was elected, he didn't actually renegotiate many of those deals.
sentences.zh: 但在特朗普总统当选后，他实际上并没有重新谈判其中的许多协定。

sentences.en: Instead, he's focused on tariff measures that have hit businesses around the world.
sentences.zh: 相反，他专注于那些打击了全球企业的关税措施。

sentences.en: Anna Swanson covers trade for The Times.
sentences.zh: 安娜·斯旺森为《时报》报道贸易新闻。

sentences.en: So, it's really my honor to start this process.
sentences.zh: 所以，开启这个进程确实是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: It's going to be a very fair process.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个非常公平的进程。

sentences.en: It's going to be very fair to other countries, especially those that treat us well.
sentences.zh: 这对其他国家来说将是非常公平的，特别是那些善待我们的国家。

sentences.en: And we look forward to it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此充满期待。

sentences.en: And we look forward to having lots of mills opening up, lots of plants opening up, both steel and aluminum.
sentences.zh: 我们期待看到许多钢厂和工厂开工，无论是钢铁还是铝业。

sentences.en: He starts in March by imposing tariffs on steel and aluminum, which is basically a tax on those goods coming into the country that raises their price.
sentences.zh: 他从三月份开始对钢铁和铝征收关税，这基本上是对进入该国的商品征税，从而提高了它们的价格。

sentences.en: We will have a 25 percent tariff on foreign steel and a 10 percent tariff on foreign aluminum when the product comes across our borders.
sentences.zh: 当产品越过我们的边境时，我们将对外国钢铁征收25%的关税，对外国铝征收10%的关税。

sentences.en: And he attacked China, Turkey, and Russia.
sentences.zh: 他还抨击了中国、土耳其和俄罗斯。

sentences.en: We're losing with China $500 billion a year.
sentences.zh: 我们每年在中国身上损失5000亿美元。

sentences.en: We have to do something.
sentences.zh: 我们必须采取行动。

sentences.en: So, when President Trump imposed these tariffs, was it surprising or was it kind of like, well, of course he's going to go after China.
sentences.zh: 那么，当特朗普总统实施这些关税时，这令人惊讶吗？还是说，嗯，他当然会针对中国。

sentences.en: That's what he promised to do as a candidate.
sentences.zh: 这就是他作为候选人时承诺要做的事情。

sentences.en: No, it wasn't that surprising that he imposed the tariffs on countries like China or Russia, because that's what he'd vowed to do on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: 不，他对中国或俄罗斯等国家实施关税并不令人惊讶，因为这就是他在竞选时发誓要做的。

sentences.en: He had criticized China very intently, and he'd made promises to the American steel industry.
sentences.zh: 他曾非常严厉地批评中国，并向美国钢铁工业做出了承诺。

sentences.en: But it was surprising when...
sentences.zh: 但令人惊讶的是……

sentences.en: The Trump administration announced today it will impose tariffs on several of its key allies.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府今天宣布，将对其几个主要盟友征收关税。

sentences.en: Two months later, he expanded those tariffs to include very close allies like the European Union, Canada, and Mexico.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，他将这些关税扩大到包括欧盟、加拿大和墨西哥等非常亲密的盟友。

sentences.en: The tariffs, 25 percent on imports of steel and 10 percent on aluminum, take effect at midnight.
sentences.zh: 这些关税，即对钢铁进口征收25%，对铝征收10%，于午夜生效。

sentences.en: And how does the Trump administration justify imposing tariffs on our allies?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府如何证明对我们的盟友征收关税是正当的？

sentences.en: So, the president argues that...
sentences.zh: 所以，总统认为……

sentences.en: The American aluminum industry has been severely damaged by unfair foreign trade.
sentences.zh: 美国铝业受到了不公平外国贸易的严重损害。

sentences.en: Cheap subsidized foreign imports have flooded into the market, destroying thousands of great American jobs, jobs that are no longer...
sentences.zh: 廉价的补贴外国进口产品涌入市场，摧毁了成千上万个伟大的美国就业岗位，这些岗位不再……

sentences.en: Really cheap imports from abroad have basically degraded American manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 来自国外的廉价进口产品基本上削弱了美国的制造业。

sentences.en: And this is particularly a problem with steel and aluminum.
sentences.zh: 这在钢铁和铝方面尤其是一个问题。

sentences.en: And so that's why he argues that we need tariffs to essentially protect that domestic industry and allow it to flourish again.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是他认为我们需要关税来从根本上保护国内产业并使其再次繁荣的原因。

sentences.en: We have to do something with intellectual property.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在知识产权方面采取行动。

sentences.en: We have to do something just generally in trade.
sentences.zh: 我们必须在贸易方面采取普遍行动。

sentences.en: Last year, we lost $500 billion with China.
sentences.zh: 去年，我们与中国的贸易逆差为5000亿美元。

sentences.en: We can't do that anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们不能再这样下去了。

sentences.en: And they are very critical of competition from China and that cheap Chinese imports are coming into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们对来自中国的竞争非常不满，认为廉价的中国进口产品正在进入美国。

sentences.en: from other countries as well, through Canada, through the European Union, and through Mexico.
sentences.zh: 也通过加拿大、欧盟和墨西哥等其他国家进入。

sentences.en: Other countries are negotiating.
sentences.zh: 其他国家正在进行谈判。

sentences.en: And without tariffs, you could never do that.
sentences.zh: 没有关税，你永远做不到这一点。

sentences.en: And the president has also talked about these tariffs as a way to negotiate better trade deals.
sentences.zh: 总统也谈到这些关税是谈判更好贸易协定的一种方式。

sentences.en: It's a kind of bargaining chip with Canada and Mexico to renegotiate the North American Free Trade Agreement or to negotiate a better trade deal with Europe as well.
sentences.zh: 这是一种与加拿大和墨西哥重新谈判《北美自由贸易协定》，或者与欧洲谈判更好贸易协定的筹码。

sentences.en: Just remember, we're the bank.
sentences.zh: 记住，我们是银行。

sentences.en: We're the bank that everybody wants to steal from and plunder.
sentences.zh: 我们是每个人都想从中窃取和掠夺的银行。

sentences.en: And it can't be that way anymore.
sentences.zh: 这种情况不能再继续下去了。

sentences.en: But ultimately, we haven't seen that much progress on the trade deals that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我们在美国与加拿大和墨西哥的贸易协定，或与欧盟的贸易协定上，并没有看到太大的进展。

sentences.en: has with Canada and Mexico or the trade deal with the European Union.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这也确实恶化了与美国许多最亲密伙伴的关系。

sentences.en: In the meantime, it's also really worsened relations with many of America's closest partners.
sentences.zh: 我们认为在两国之间对钢铁或铝征收任何新关税或任何关税是绝对不可接受的。

sentences.en: We regard the imposition of any new tariffs or any tariffs on steel or aluminum between our two countries as absolutely unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 我们认为在两国之间对钢铁或铝征收任何新关税或任何关税是绝对不可接受的。

sentences.en: And many allies like the European Union and Canada are pretty furious with trade relations right now.
sentences.zh: 许多盟友，如欧盟和加拿大，现在对贸易关系感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: We stand ready to respond swiftly, firmly, and in a proportionate manner on the basis and as required by WTO rules.
sentences.zh: 我们随时准备根据世贸组织规则的要求，迅速、坚定并以对等方式做出回应。

sentences.en: So they start retaliating.
sentences.zh: 所以他们开始报复。

sentences.en: Firing back, China responded within hours to President Donald Trump's announcement of the tariffs, focusing on agriculture, wine, fruit, nuts and pork products,
sentences.zh: 中国在唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布关税后的几小时内就做出了反击，重点针对农产品、葡萄酒、水果、坚果和猪肉产品，

sentences.en: but also recycled aluminum and steel pipes.
sentences.zh: 但也包括回收铝和钢管。

sentences.en: China first responds with tariffs on about $3 billion of American products.
sentences.zh: 中国首先对约30亿美元的美国产品征收关税。

sentences.en: Starting today, the European Union is striking back at the United States with tariffs.
sentences.zh: 从今天开始，欧盟正以关税回击美国。

sentences.en: The European Union jumps in with its own tariffs on about $7 billion of products.
sentences.zh: 欧盟也加入进来，对约70亿美元的产品征收自己的关税。

sentences.en: And it picks really iconic American goods, including blue jeans, bourbon and Harley-Davidson's.
sentences.zh: 它挑选了极具代表性的美国商品，包括牛仔裤、波本威士忌和哈雷摩托车。

sentences.en: Here at this Harley-Davidson dealership just outside Brussels in Belgium, this bike will cost about $30,000.
sentences.zh: 在比利时布鲁塞尔郊外的这家哈雷摩托车经销商处，这辆摩托车的售价约为3万美元。

sentences.en: Mexico and Canada also respond with their own tariffs that are targeted at major exporters.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥和加拿大也做出了回应，对主要出口商征收了各自的关税。

sentences.en: Mexico vowing to slap fees on American pork, fruit and steel.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥发誓要对美国的猪肉、水果和钢铁征收费用。

sentences.en: Products like ketchup, whiskey, yogurt, chocolate, they're all strategically chosen.
sentences.zh: 像番茄酱、威士忌、酸奶、巧克力这样的产品，都是经过战略性挑选的。

sentences.en: So these countries are retaliating with their own tariffs that seem deliberately aimed at classic, essential American goods.
sentences.zh: 所以这些国家正在用他们自己的关税进行报复，这些关税似乎是故意针对经典的、必不可少的美国商品。

sentences.en: Yes, but they're also trying to target American goods in places that have very powerful representatives.
sentences.zh: 是的，但他们也试图针对那些拥有非常有权势的代表的地区的美国商品。

sentences.en: From a Kentucky point of view, NAFTA has been a big winner.
sentences.zh: 从肯塔基州的角度来看，NAFTA 是一个大赢家。

sentences.en: And so I think the best way to characterize where most Republican senators are right now, including myself, is genuine concern that this not escalate into something much broader.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，描述大多数共和党参议员（包括我自己）目前立场的最好方式是，真诚地担心这不会升级为更广泛的冲突。

sentences.en: Kentucky, which is the home state of Mitch McConnell, was targeted.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州是米奇·麦康奈尔的家乡，成为了目标。

sentences.en: Well, look, we think the economy is doing very well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，我们认为经济表现非常好。

sentences.en: We want to make sure that every step we take helps the economy.
sentences.zh: 我们想确保我们采取的每一步都有助于经济。

sentences.en: We want to make sure that abusers are held to account, especially China, when it comes to dumping and transshipping.
sentences.zh: 我们想确保滥用者被追究责任，特别是在倾销和转运方面，中国尤其如此。

sentences.en: But we also want to make sure that every step we take forward does not create any unintended consequences.
sentences.zh: 但我们也想确保我们向前迈出的每一步都不会产生任何意想不到的后果。

sentences.en: As well as Wisconsin, where House Speaker Paul Ryan is from.
sentences.zh: 以及众议院议长保罗·瑞安所在的威斯康星州。

sentences.en: Many goods from those states were picked up in this retaliation.
sentences.zh: 来自这些州的许多商品都被纳入了这次报复行动。

sentences.en: And what's the point of that?
sentences.zh: 这样做有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: These countries are hoping to put pressure on people in those districts and then pressure some of the most prominent politicians in the Republican Party to then take their case to the president and argue that these tariffs should be removed.
sentences.zh: 这些国家希望向这些选区的人施压，进而向共和党内一些最著名的政治人物施压，让他们向总统提出诉求，主张取消这些关税。

sentences.en: So it's as much a message to these Republican lawmakers as it is to the administration about the dangers of tariffs.
sentences.zh: 所以这既是给这些共和党议员的信息，也是给政府关于关税危险性的警告。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think what's important to note is just how quickly this is escalating.
sentences.zh: 我认为值得注意的是，这种升级速度有多快。

sentences.en: So we've gone from having tariffs on just a few billion dollars of goods to now having tariffs on about $92 billion of foreign products right now.
sentences.zh: 我们已经从仅对几十亿美元的商品征收关税，发展到目前对约920亿美元的外国产品征收关税。

sentences.en: And the president has threatened tariffs on hundreds of billions of dollars more of products.
sentences.zh: 总统还威胁要对数千亿美元的更多产品征收关税。

sentences.en: So that could expand very quickly in the months to come.
sentences.zh: 所以这在未来几个月内可能会迅速扩大。

sentences.en: So this tit-for-tat on hundreds of billions of dollars of products on both sides, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，美国和我们的贸易伙伴在数千亿美元产品上的这种针锋相对，是否意味着我们现在正处于一场全面的贸易战中？

sentences.en: and our trading partners, does that mean we're now engaged in a full-fledged trade war?
sentences.zh: 我会说绝对有可能。

sentences.en: I would say definitely maybe.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，你知道，关于贸易战重要的一点是，你会陷入这种以关税回应关税的循环中。

sentences.en: But I think, you know, the important thing about a trade war is that you get locked into this cycle of responding to tariffs with more tariffs.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为从这个意义上说，

sentences.en: So I think in that sense,
sentences.zh: 我们绝对处于一场贸易战中，因为你看到了这种恶性的自我复制循环，美国正在实施这些严厉措施，而其他国家别无选择，只能以同样的惩罚性关税进行回应。

sentences.en: we definitely are in a trade war because you're seeing this kind of vicious self-replicating cycle where the United States is imposing these tough measures and other countries have no choice but to respond with the same kind of punitive tariffs.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对处于一场贸易战中，因为你看到了这种恶性的自我复制循环，美国正在实施这些严厉措施，而其他国家别无选择，只能以同样的惩罚性关税进行回应。

sentences.en: And who's being hit the hardest by this cycle of U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，在这场美国针对外国商品的关税和外国针对美国商品的关税循环中，谁受到的打击最严重？

sentences.en: tariffs against foreign goods and foreign tariffs against U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那些真正依赖外国市场销售产品的农民受到的打击非常严重。

sentences.en: goods?
sentences.zh: 商品？

sentences.en: Well, farmers who really rely on foreign markets to sell their products are being hit really hard.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那些真正依赖外国市场销售产品的农民受到的打击非常严重。

sentences.en: I'm going to guess 90% of our soybeans are exported and probably 70% of our corn.
sentences.zh: 我猜我们90%的大豆和可能70%的玉米都是出口的。

sentences.en: So soybean farmers have been hit really hard by falling prices.
sentences.zh: 所以大豆农民因价格下跌而受到了沉重打击。

sentences.en: It could easily affect our profit by or increase our loss by, I don't know if 30% is out of line or not, but it's, I'm just going to throw that number out there and hope I'm wrong.
sentences.zh: 这很容易影响我们的利润，或者增加我们的损失，我不知道30%是否离谱，但我只是抛出这个数字，希望我是错的。

sentences.en: So once these tariffs went into effect, it raised the price of their goods in foreign markets and makes them less appealing to foreign consumers.
sentences.zh: 所以一旦这些关税生效，它就提高了他们的商品在外国市场的价格，使它们对外国消费者失去了吸引力。

sentences.en: And that's led to sales dropping off.
sentences.zh: 这导致了销售额的下降。

sentences.en: China, for example, has been buying soybeans from other countries, including Brazil, instead of the United States.
sentences.zh: 例如，中国一直在从包括巴西在内的其他国家购买大豆，而不是从美国购买。

sentences.en: And then you've also seen farmers respond by reducing their own expenditures.
sentences.zh: 然后你也会看到农民通过减少自己的支出做出反应。

sentences.en: So they're deciding not to buy that new tractor or that new grain silo.
sentences.zh: 所以他们决定不买那台新拖拉机或那个新粮仓。

sentences.en: And so that's having ripples through the farm economy.
sentences.zh: 所以这在农业经济中产生了连锁反应。

sentences.en: So how are these farmers reacting to the decline of their business at the hands of these tariffs from the Trump administration?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些农民对特朗普政府关税导致的业务下滑有何反应？

sentences.en: So far, many farmers I've talked to have been surprisingly patient.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我交谈过的许多农民都表现得令人惊讶地耐心。

sentences.en: They say that this is a negotiating tactic and they're willing to stick with the president.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是一种谈判策略，他们愿意支持总统。

sentences.en: These were the constituencies that were strong supporters of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 这些选民是特朗普总统的坚定支持者。

sentences.en: I still would, given the facts I had at election day, I would still have voted for him.
sentences.zh: 考虑到选举日我掌握的事实，我仍然会投票给他。

sentences.en: But I, obviously at that day, I did not appreciate that it was going to be this dramatic.
sentences.zh: 但我显然在当时并没有意识到情况会变得如此戏剧化。

sentences.en: And I'm very concerned and hopefully things will play out a little better than what it looks like today.
sentences.zh: 我非常担心，希望事情的发展会比今天看起来的要好一点。

sentences.en: And try to hang on and let it get sorted out.
sentences.zh: 并试着坚持下去，让问题得到解决。

sentences.en: But the question is, how long can they sustain these losses and still support his trade agenda?
sentences.zh: 但问题是，他们能承受这些损失多久，并继续支持他的贸易议程？

sentences.en: The Trump administration says help is on the way for American farmers.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府表示，美国农民的援助即将到来。

sentences.en: That's why on Tuesday he announced a program to help them.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他在周二宣布了一项帮助他们的计划。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: Department of Agriculture introduced a $12 billion plan to help farmers who are feeling financial pain from China's retaliatory tariffs.
sentences.zh: 农业部推出了一个120亿美元的计划，以帮助那些因中国的报复性关税而感到经济痛苦的农民。

sentences.en: So what does that actually look like, a $12 million bailout for farmers?
sentences.zh: 那么，120亿美元的农民救助计划实际上是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, it's a pretty big number.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个相当大的数字。

sentences.en: And we're told it will involve direct payments to farmers to help them with the pain of these tariffs that they're facing abroad.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知，它将涉及向农民提供直接付款，以帮助他们应对在国外面临的这些关税带来的痛苦。

sentences.en: And the money will go to soybean farmers, dairy farmers and pork producers, among others.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱将流向大豆农民、奶农和猪肉生产商等。

sentences.en: OK, so just to be sure I understand this, President Trump, in pursuing his America first approach to what he sees as unfair trade deals,
sentences.zh: 好的，为了确保我理解这一点，特朗普总统在追求他所谓的“美国优先”方针以应对他认为不公平的贸易协定时，

sentences.en: starts a trade war that ends up hurting the American farmer.
sentences.zh: 发起了一场最终伤害了美国农民的贸易战。

sentences.en: And now to help out those farmers, he's initiating this $12 billion bailout for them.
sentences.zh: 现在为了帮助这些农民，他正在为他们发起这项120亿美元的救助计划。

sentences.en: That kind of feels a little bit like chasing your tail, causing a problem that costs a lot of money and then spending a lot of money to fix the problem you caused.
sentences.zh: 这感觉有点像是在做无用功，制造了一个花费巨大代价的问题，然后又花费巨资去解决你所造成的问题。

sentences.en: That's the criticism he has received.
sentences.zh: 这就是他所受到的批评。

sentences.en: So farmers,
sentences.zh: 所以农民、

sentences.en: farm groups and Republican senators have definitely been positive about this plan in the short term and grateful that the president is doing something to help farmers that have been hurt by this trade war.
sentences.zh: 农业团体和共和党参议员在短期内对该计划确实持积极态度，并感谢总统采取行动帮助那些受这场贸易战伤害的农民。

sentences.en: But a lot of the criticism has focused on the fact that these measures tend to be kind of clunky.
sentences.zh: 但很多批评集中在这些措施往往显得有些笨拙的事实上。

sentences.en: So first, they have to figure out which farmers are hurt.
sentences.zh: 所以首先，他们必须弄清楚哪些农民受到了伤害。

sentences.en: It'll take them a while to get these payments.
sentences.zh: 他们拿到这些补贴还需要一段时间。

sentences.en: And then, of course, we're using U.S.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们正在动用美国

sentences.en: taxpayer money to compensate farmers for the pain of a trade war.
sentences.zh: 纳税人的钱来补偿农民，以缓解贸易战带来的痛苦。

sentences.en: And critics are saying it's better just not to cause the trade war in the first place.
sentences.zh: 批评人士则认为，从一开始就不引发贸易战才是更好的选择。

sentences.en: I mean, how is the Trump administration, Ana, talking about this bailout?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，安娜，特朗普政府是如何谈论这项救助计划的？

sentences.en: It wouldn't seem like this could be framed as a sign that the trade war is succeeding if you have to bail out American farmers because they are victims of the trade war.
sentences.zh: 如果你必须救助美国农民，因为他们是贸易战的受害者，那么这似乎很难被解读为贸易战正在取得成功的迹象。

sentences.en: The farmers will be the biggest beneficiary.
sentences.zh: 农民将是最大的受益者。

sentences.en: Watch.
sentences.zh: 请看。

sentences.en: We're opening up markets.
sentences.zh: 我们正在开放市场。

sentences.en: You watch what's going down.
sentences.zh: 你看着事情的发展吧。

sentences.en: Just be a little patient.
sentences.zh: 稍微耐心一点。

sentences.en: Well, in general, they've said that the pain that this trade war is causing is really small compared to the potential benefits and compared to the size of the overall economy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，总的来说，他们表示，这场贸易战造成的痛苦与潜在的收益以及整体经济规模相比，其实是非常小的。

sentences.en: Meaning temporary pain leads to greater trade deals, which bring bigger gains to the whole economy.
sentences.zh: 意思是暂时的痛苦会带来更好的贸易协议，从而为整个经济带来更大的收益。

sentences.en: That's the idea.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的想法。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So farmers may be experiencing some temporary pain right now.
sentences.zh: 所以农民现在可能正在经历一些暂时的痛苦。

sentences.en: But the administration describes this as part of a negotiating strategy where the president is going to be forging these new deals that are better for American farmers.
sentences.zh: 但政府将其描述为谈判策略的一部分，总统将通过这一策略达成对美国农民更有利的新协议。

sentences.en: The question for many farmers is just how long will this take and whether they'll be able to absorb the losses in the meantime.
sentences.zh: 许多农民的问题在于，这到底需要多长时间，以及在此期间他们是否能够承受损失。

sentences.en: Is there any indication, Ana, that this strategy will actually work and that the future the president is outlining will actually come to fruition?
sentences.zh: 安娜，有什么迹象表明这一策略真的会奏效，而总统所描绘的未来真的会实现吗？

sentences.en: So far, these countries are not caving to the pressure of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这些国家并没有屈服于特朗普政府的压力。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, we're seeing these countries that have been hit by U.S.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们看到那些在贸易战中受到美国

sentences.en: tariffs in this trade war.
sentences.zh: 关税打击的国家，

sentences.en: They are negotiating their own big trade deals with each other without the U.S.
sentences.zh: 正在绕开美国，彼此之间商谈各自的大型贸易协议。

sentences.en: The EU just signed a major trade deal with Japan.
sentences.zh: 欧盟刚刚与日本签署了一项重大贸易协议。

sentences.en: It also updated its agreement with Mexico.
sentences.zh: 它还更新了与墨西哥的协议。

sentences.en: And then the remaining countries of the Trans-Pacific Partnership, including Japan and a lot of countries around the Pacific Rim,
sentences.zh: 此外，跨太平洋伙伴关系协定的其余国家，包括日本和环太平洋地区的许多国家，

sentences.en: have moved forward with that trade deal without the United States as well.
sentences.zh: 也已经在没有美国参与的情况下推进了该贸易协议。

sentences.en: So the countries that we have hit with tariffs, in order to get them to negotiate better trade deals with the U.S., they are going off and negotiating their own trade deals,
sentences.zh: 所以，那些被我们征收关税以迫使他们与美国商谈更好贸易协议的国家，他们正在转而去商谈自己的贸易协议，

sentences.en: just not with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 只是不跟美国谈。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the president's trade strategy relies really heavily on this idea of America first, of America being the largest economy and the indispensable market,
sentences.zh: 所以总统的贸易策略在很大程度上依赖于“美国优先”的理念，即美国是最大的经济体和不可或缺的市场，

sentences.en: and that the Trump administration can use that to get concessions from trading partners.
sentences.zh: 并且特朗普政府可以利用这一点从贸易伙伴那里获得让步。

sentences.en: And I think that's still true.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一点仍然成立。

sentences.en: I mean, America is the most powerful economy and a lot of countries see it as indispensable.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，美国确实是最强大的经济体，许多国家也认为它不可或缺。

sentences.en: But it's not as indispensable as it was 10 years ago.
sentences.zh: 但它已经不像10年前那样不可或缺了。

sentences.en: I mean, China has been growing economically, and the European Union, their economy is as large as the United States.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，中国在经济上一直在增长，而欧盟的经济规模也已经和美国相当。

sentences.en: And when other countries see that the United States is taking this aggressive posture and is not willing to do trade deals, they have other options.
sentences.zh: 当其他国家看到美国采取这种咄咄逼人的姿态且不愿达成贸易协议时，他们还有其他选择。

sentences.en: On this trade war that we're talking about, given what it's doing to our place in the global trade order, given that our trading partners are starting to do deals without us,
sentences.zh: 关于我们正在讨论的这场贸易战，考虑到它对我们在全球贸易秩序中地位的影响，考虑到我们的贸易伙伴开始在没有我们的情况下达成协议，

sentences.en: and based on the scale of this bailout to farmers that you've talked about, this is all starting to feel like a major economic event for the United States.
sentences.zh: 再加上你提到的对农民的救助规模，这一切开始让人觉得这是美国的一件重大经济事件。

sentences.en: And yet its effect is not yet really being felt by people outside of some of the industries we're talking about, like farming and in the larger economy.
sentences.zh: 然而，除了我们提到的农业等行业以及更广泛的经济领域外，人们尚未真正感受到它的影响。

sentences.en: How long do you think that will be the case?
sentences.zh: 你认为这种情况还会持续多久？

sentences.en: Well, the economy is doing really well right now, and I do think that will prevent this pain of the trade war from being felt for a while.
sentences.zh: 嗯，目前经济表现非常好，我确实认为这在一段时间内会掩盖贸易战带来的痛苦。

sentences.en: We're also feeling the positive effects of the huge tax cut that the Trump administration brought into effect.
sentences.zh: 我们也在感受特朗普政府实施的大规模减税政策所带来的积极影响。

sentences.en: And that's all helping to mask the impact of this.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都有助于掩盖贸易战的影响。

sentences.en: But the bailout is really the first sign of how bad some of the damage is and how much some of these communities are hurting.
sentences.zh: 但救助计划确实是损害程度有多严重以及一些社区受损有多深的首个迹象。

sentences.en: And I think it is a Band-Aid, but there's still a wound there that the trade war has caused.
sentences.zh: 我认为这只是创可贴，但贸易战造成的伤口依然存在。

sentences.en: And the question really is, you know, where this is going to lead us in the future.
sentences.zh: 真正的问题是，你知道，这在未来会将我们引向何方。

sentences.en: We are hearing about businesses rewriting their contracts and deciding not to buy from American producers anymore because of these tariffs.
sentences.zh: 我们听说企业正在重写合同，并决定因为这些关税而不再从美国生产商那里采购。

sentences.en: So the question is, you know, where this is going to lead us in five or 10 years, we may wake up and some of these foreign markets will be gone.
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，你知道，这在五年或十年后会将我们引向何方，我们可能会一觉醒来发现其中一些外国市场已经消失了。

sentences.en: Be gone to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 对美国而言

sentences.en: entirely.
sentences.zh: 彻底消失。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So some producers have told me that, you know, already they're seeing their foreign customers say that their products are just too expensive and they're shifting to, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以一些生产商告诉我，你知道，他们已经看到外国客户说他们的产品太贵了，他们正在转向，你知道，

sentences.en: buy from other countries instead of the United States.
sentences.zh: 从其他国家而不是美国购买。

sentences.en: So from everything you're saying,
sentences.zh: 所以根据你所说的一切，

sentences.en: it sounds like this America first trade strategy that candidate Donald Trump promised and President Donald Trump has imposed in the form of tariffs may very well end up not putting America firSt.
sentences.zh: 听起来候选人唐纳德·特朗普承诺、总统唐纳德·特朗普以关税形式强加的这种“美国优先”贸易策略，很可能最终并不能让美国优先。

sentences.en: It really hinges on whether this is a negotiating strategy and whether the president is able to come out with better deals.
sentences.zh: 这真的取决于这是否是一种谈判策略，以及总统是否能够达成更好的协议。

sentences.en: But right now, that result is very much in question, I think.
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，我认为这一结果非常令人怀疑。

sentences.en: Anna, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 安娜，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Officials from the European Union will travel to Washington today to present the Trump administration with ideas for easing the trade war.
sentences.zh: 欧盟官员今天将前往华盛顿，向特朗普政府提出缓解贸易战的建议。

sentences.en: In his latest escalation, President Trump is considering tariffs on foreign automobiles and auto parts, a plan strongly opposed by the EU.
sentences.zh: 在最新的升级行动中，特朗普总统正在考虑对外国汽车和汽车零部件征收关税，这一计划遭到了欧盟的强烈反对。

sentences.en: The Times reports that no matter what the EU proposes, it is likely to face skepticism from Trump, who recently called the EU a foe of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，无论欧盟提出什么建议，都很可能遭到特朗普的怀疑，他最近称欧盟是美国的敌人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代去夜店打碟的时候，你每天晚上都要带着你最珍视的300件宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个充满50年历史精美文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重塑者》吧。

sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》，立即下载《泰晤士报》应用程序，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他新闻。

sentences.en: I need to open up a company for the transfer of all of that info regarding our friend David, you know, so that I'm going to do that right away.
sentences.zh: 我需要开一家公司来转移所有关于我们朋友大卫的信息，你知道，所以我打算马上就做。

sentences.en: I've actually come up and I've spoken to Alan Weisselberg about how to set the whole thing up with funding.
sentences.zh: 实际上我已经找过艾伦·魏塞尔伯格，谈过如何用资金来筹备这一切。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night, President Trump's former lawyer, Michael Cohen,
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，特朗普总统的前律师迈克尔·科恩，

sentences.en: released the secret recording of a conversation with Trump about paying off a former Playboy model who said she had had an affair with Trump.
sentences.zh: 公布了一段与特朗普的秘密录音，内容是关于向一名声称与特朗普有染的前《花花公子》模特支付封口费。

sentences.en: When it comes time for the financing, which will be...
sentences.zh: 当涉及到融资的时候，那将是……

sentences.en: Listen, what financing?
sentences.zh: 听着，什么融资？

sentences.en: We'll have to pay.
sentences.zh: 我们得付钱。

sentences.en: So, no, no, no, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 所以，不，不，不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: In the 2016 recording, broadcast by CNN, Trump appears to suggest paying the model, Karen McDougal, in cash, to keep her from discussing the relationship,
sentences.zh: 在CNN播出的2016年录音中，特朗普似乎建议以现金支付给模特凯伦·麦克杜格尔，以阻止她谈论这段关系，

sentences.en: a suggestion rejected by Cohen.
sentences.zh: 这一建议遭到了科恩的拒绝。

sentences.en: The release of the tape is the latest sign that Cohen is prepared to cooperate with federal prosecutors as they examine whether payments to women like McDougal violated campaign finance laws.
sentences.zh: 这段录音的发布是科恩准备与联邦检察官合作的最新迹象，他们正在调查向麦克杜格尔等女性支付的款项是否违反了竞选财务法。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场痛苦、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 《地铁》。
